qe: Which is described as the oldest established among the social institutions of the Patna district, with its club house on the bank of the Ganges at Bankipore?
qh: पटना जिले की सामाजिक संस्थाओं में सबसे पुरानी कौन मानी जाती है, जिसका क्लब भवन बांकीपुर में गंगा के किनारे है?
e: Patna jile ki sabse purani sthapit samajik sanstha Bankipore Club mani jaati hai, jiska vistar pichhle saalon me kaafi badha tha. Iska club ghar Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare, Collectorate ke daftaron ke purab me sthit tha. Isi shahar me New Patna Club ki sthapna Mr. Justice F. R. Roe ke prayas se hui, unhone is kaam me Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das tatha Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed ka sahyog liya tha; is club me yuropiy tatha bharatiy mila kar assi sadasya the. South Bihar Gymkhana Club ki shuruaat bhi Mr. Justice Roe se judi maani jaati hai, jahan golf links tatha polo ground tha. Aise sansthan dikhate hain ki us daur me shahar ke padhe-likhe tatha sampann logon ka samajik jeevan naye-naye clubon tatha sabhaon ke aas-paas banna shuru ho gaya tha. Exam point: Bankipore Club sabse purani sthapit samajik sanstha thi tatha uska club ghar Bankipore me Ganga ke kinare, Collectorate ke purab me tha; New Patna Club ki sthapna Mr. Justice F. R. Roe ke prayas se hui, jisme Sir Ali Imam tatha Mr. Justice P. R. Das ne sahyog kiya; is club me yuropiy tatha bharatiy mila kar assi sadasya the.

qe: The New Patna Club owed its origin to which Judge, assisted by Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das and Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed?
qh: न्यू पटना क्लब की स्थापना किस जज के प्रयास से हुई, जिन्हें सर अली इमाम, मिस्टर जस्टिस पी. आर. दास तथा मिस्टर सैयद सुल्तान अहमद का सहयोग मिला?
e: Nayi rajdhani ban jane ke baad Patna me samajik jeevan tez gati se badla. Isi daur me new capital me New Patna Club ki sthapna hui, jiski shuruaat Mr. Justice F. R. Roe se judi maani jaati hai; unhone is kaam me Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das tatha Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed ka sahyog liya. Is club ka bhawan achha tha tatha isme assi sadasya the, jinme yuropiy tatha bharatiy dono shamil the. South Bihar Gymkhana Club ki shuruaat bhi usi jaj se jodi jaati hai, jahan golf links tatha polo ground bana, chahe ve jitna nirman chahte the utna nahi ho paaya. Aise club tatha khel-maidan dikhate hain ki nayi rajdhani me angreji tarz ka samajik jeevan tatha khel-kood ka rivaaj tezi se phaila. Exam point: New Patna Club ki shuruaat Mr. Justice F. R. Roe se judi hai, jinhone Sir Ali Imam, Mr. Justice P. R. Das tatha Mr. Saiyid Sultan Ahmed ke saath milkar ise banaya; club me assi sadasya the tatha yuropiy aur bharatiy dono shamil the; South Bihar Gymkhana Club bhi unhi ke prayas se shuru hui, jahan golf links tatha polo ground tha.

qe: Which association, with its headquarters at Patna, represented the interests of the landlords of the whole of Bihar?
qh: किस संस्था का मुख्यालय पटना में था तथा वह पूरे बिहार के ज़मींदारों के हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करती थी?
e: Nayi rajdhani ban jane ke baad Patna me kai samajik tatha rajnitik sansthaayein bani. Inme Bihar Landholders' Association ka naam mahatvapurn tha, jiska mukhyalay Patna me tha tatha jo poore Bihar ke zamindaron ke hiton ka pratinidhitva karti thi. Isi shahar me Indian National Congress ki ek shakha tatha Kayasth Sabha ki shakha bhi thi, jo Kayasth samuday ke hiton ko aage badhane ke liye banayi gayi thi. Bihar Hitaishi Library Patna city me ek vachanalay yaani reading-room thi, jisse shahar ke padhe-likhe tatha sampann log jude hue the; tatha Victoria Jubilee Club ek sampoorna samajik sanstha thi, jo Bankipore tatha Patna ke paschim hisse ke bharatiy samaj dwara chalai jaati thi. Aise sansthan dikhate hain ki Patna ab ek aise kendra ke roop me ubhar raha tha jahan rajnitik tatha samajik andolanon ka sangathan hota tha. Exam point: Bihar Landholders' Association ka mukhyalay Patna me tha tatha yah poore Bihar ke zamindaron ke hiton ka pratinidhitva karti thi; Patna me Indian National Congress ki shakha tatha Kayasth Sabha ki shakha bhi thi; Bihar Hitaishi Library Patna city ka ek padhne-kaksh tha tatha Victoria Jubilee Club ek samajik sanstha thi.

qe: Which Muhammadan association of Patna dealt mainly with social questions and kept a watchful eye on the progress of events bearing on the interests of Muhammadans, and of the Sunni sect in particular?
qh: पटना की कौन-सी मुस्लिम संस्था मुख्यतः सामाजिक प्रश्नों पर काम करती थी तथा मुसलमानों, विशेष रूप से सुन्नी वर्ग, के हितों से जुड़ी घटनाओं पर नज़र रखती थी?
e: Patna me kai samudayon tatha vichardhaaraon ki apni sansthaayein ban gayi thin, isliye shahar ka samajik jeevan bahut vividh ho gaya. Muhammadan samuday ki ek sanstha Anjuman Islamia thi, jo mukhya roop se samajik sawalon par kaam karti thi tatha Mussalmanon, khaas taur par Sunni varg, ke hiton se jude aayojanon par nazar rakhti thi. Inke alava Bihar Young Men's Institute, Theosophical Society tatha Gorakshini Sabha jaisi sansthaayein bhi thin. Gorakshini Sabha pashuon yaani gai-bail ki suraksha ke liye banayi gayi thi tatha ise Marwari tatha vyapari varg ke log zyada chandaa dete the, jo apne dharmik vishwas me adhik utsah dikhate the. Is tarah ek hi shahar me dharm, jati tatha vyapar ke aadhaar par bani alag-alag sansthaayein saath-saath kaam kar rahi thin. Exam point: Anjuman Islamia Patna ki Muhammadan sanstha thi jo samajik prashnon par kaam karti thi tatha Mussalmanon, khaas taur par Sunni varg, ke hiton se jude vishayon par nazar rakhti thi; Patna me Bihar Young Men's Institute, Theosophical Society tatha Gorakshini Sabha jaisi sansthaayein bhi thin; Gorakshini Sabha pashuon ki suraksha ke liye thi tatha usse Marwari tatha vyapari varg zyada jude the.

qe: The Bihari newspaper developed from a paper founded in 1894. What was that earlier paper called, and when did the Bihari begin to be published daily?
qh: बिहारी अखबार 1894 में शुरू हुए एक अखबार से विकसित हुआ था। वह पुराना अखबार क्या कहलाता था तथा बिहारी दैनिक रूप में कब छपने लगा?
oe: The Bihar Times, published daily from April 1912
oh: बिहार टाइम्स, जो अप्रैल 1912 से दैनिक छपने लगा
e: Naye prant ban jane ke baad Patna me theek-thak rashtriy samachar-patra nikaalne ki kai koshishen hui; kuch samachar-patra kuch samay tak achhe chale, lekin aage chalkar band ho gaye. Inme sabse ullekhniy 'Bihari' tha, jo 1894 me shuru hue 'Bihar Times' se vikasit hua tatha April 1912 se dainik roop me chhapne laga. Germany ke saath yuddh ke shuru hone par, jab samachar ki maang bahut badhi, use kaafi faayda hua; lekin 1917 me yah band ho gaya. Isi daur ka ek aur achha samachar-patra 'The Express' tha, jise Hathwa ke Maharaja ki aarthik madad prapt thi; yuddh ke samay yah do baar roz chhapta tha, baad me shaam ka akhbaar ban gaya tatha May 1922 me band ho gaya, lekin agli sardiyon me phir shuru kar diya gaya. Inke alava Patna se Bihar Herald tatha Searchlight angreji me tatha Siksha hindi me chap rahe the. Exam point: Bihari akhbaar 1894 me shuru hue Bihar Times se bana tatha April 1912 se dainik chhapne laga; Germany ke saath yuddh ke dauran use faayda hua, lekin 1917 me band ho gaya; The Express Hathwa ke Maharaja ki madad se chalta tha, May 1922 me band hone ke baad agli sardiyon me phir shuru hua; Patna se Bihar Herald tatha Searchlight angreji me tatha Siksha hindi me nikalte the.

qe: Which newspaper of Patna was financed by the Maharaja of Hathwa and appeared twice daily during the war?
qh: पटना का कौन-सा अखबार हथुआ के महाराजा की आर्थिक सहायता से चलता था तथा युद्ध के समय दिन में दो बार छपता था?
e: Patna se nikalne wale akhbaaron me 'The Express' apne tareeke se alag tha. Is akhbaar ki aarthik vyavastha Hathwa ke Maharaja ke sahyog se chalti thi tatha ise achhe tareeke se chalaya jaata tha. Yuddh ke dauran yah din me do baar chhapta tha, lekin baad me yah shaam ka akhbaar ban gaya. May 1922 me iska prakshan band ho gaya, lekin agli sardiyon me ise phir se shuru kar diya gaya; iske alava Patna se abhi Bihar Herald tatha Searchlight angreji me tatha Siksha hindi me nikal rahe the. Isi shahar ka 'Bihari' akhbaar 1894 me shuru hue Bihar Times se bana tha, jo April 1912 se dainik hua tatha 1917 me band ho gaya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki nayi rajdhani me samachar-patraon ka bazaar abhi bana hua tha - kuch chalte the, kuch band hote the tatha sarkari tatha niji sahyog ka unpar bada asar tha. Exam point: The Express akhbaar Hathwa ke Maharaja ki aarthik madad se chalta tha; yuddh ke samay yah din me do baar chhapta tha tatha baad me shaam ka akhbaar ban gaya; May 1922 me band hone ke baad agli sardiyon me phir shuru hua; Patna se Bihar Herald, Searchlight tatha Siksha bhi nikalte the.
